hard_rules: Choose none unless a device is load-bearing for visible sentence meaning or cinematic continuity
Never invent a beat, subject, motion, or spatial relation to justify a device
The canonical topology keeps ownership of panel count and reading order
Only the local materializer may write bounds, polygons, border relations, z-index, or breakout fields

best_for: the selected canonical topology and cinematic shots already carry the complete sentence
avoid_when: one supported device is necessary to make a visible sentence relation readable
devices.reference_contract: source_panel, target_panel, and subject_id are empty strings
devices.deterministic_materialization: Preserve canonical geometry and contained subjects without specialization

best_for: one visible subject physically continues into the next adjacent shot
a sentence-supported handoff, chase, fall, or reach crosses one gutter
avoid_when: the source and destination shots are not adjacent
more than one subject would cross
devices.reference_contract: source_panel and target_panel are adjacent shot ids; subject_id exists in the source shot
devices.deterministic_materialization: Enable exactly one breakout from the canonical source panel toward the canonical destination panel without moving either panel

best_for: rapid progression or two perspectives compressed in time
avoid_when: different places or times need strict separation
the selected topology already uses trapezoidal panels
devices.reference_contract: source_panel is the foreground shot id; target_panel is one adjacent background shot id; subject_id is empty
devices.deterministic_materialization: Extend the foreground canonical slot through one gutter by a bounded registry-owned amount and assign one higher z-index overlap relation

best_for: one existing shot is a decisive hand, eye, clue, or object detail inside a larger spatial shot
point-of-view refinement without leaving the parent scene
avoid_when: the detail repeats the parent image
the page requires strictly equal independent beats
the inset would hide a protected face, hand, action, or reading entry
devices.reference_contract: source_panel is the parent shot id; target_panel is the existing detail shot id; subject_id is empty
devices.deterministic_materialization: Place the target slot inside a protected upper-right safe zone of the source slot with a fixed higher z-index

best_for: memory, atmosphere, scale, emotional release, or a view dissolving into its environment
avoid_when: removing a border would merge unrelated beats
the selected topology is already a diagonal strip
devices.reference_contract: source_panel is the one borderless shot id; target_panel and subject_id are empty
devices.deterministic_materialization: Change exactly one canonical panel to open_frame with border none without changing its clip bounds

best_for: one subject performs ordered visible phases through one continuous place
the physical route itself teaches the target meaning
avoid_when: the same environment and subject cannot remain visually stable
devices.reference_contract: source_panel and target_panel are distinct participating shot ids; subject_id occurs in every panel sharing their nonempty environment id with distinct subject phases
devices.deterministic_materialization: Map the declared endpoint shot ids to canonical panels and preserve the model-authored shared environment and phase contract

best_for: one sentence-supported directional change or release follows the canonical diagonal route
the slanted progression clarifies motion, separation, or convergence
avoid_when: the diagonal geometry would be decorative rather than semantic
devices.reference_contract: source_panel is the first shot id; target_panel is the last shot id; subject_id is empty
devices.deterministic_materialization: Bind the declared endpoints to the first and last canonical trapezoidal slots without altering registry geometry
